summary: Post-market: the US session closed firmly, with the Dow posting its best day in nearly two months and the S&P 500 at fresh highs; semis led with AMD +7.00%, MU +7.62%, AVGO +6.61% and NVDA +2.56%. The total risk score held at 41.05 (caution, goldilocks regime), flat on the day, as macro remains the dominant risk (10Y real rate 2.43%, 10Y yield 4.70%) while credit stays benign (HY OAS 2.78, IG OAS 0.78) and VIX eased to 15.86. After the bell, reactions were mixed: AMD's data center revenue grew 107% but its shares fell, and SpaceX slid after its first earnings report. Data coverage is degraded across most domains; model confidence is 0.77.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10Y real rate at 2.43% sits at the 99.05th percentile, keeping the macro dimension (76.4) the dominant risk.
The 10Y yield of 4.70% (98.25th percentile) keeps borrowing costs elevated.
New-highs participation is only 25% even as 87.5% of names hold above their 200-day average — the rally is narrower than headline strength suggests.
Cross-asset confirmation remains weak at 0.17, yet it is the largest single contributor (7.5) to the total score.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit is benign: HY OAS at 2.78 and IG OAS at 0.78, with spreads tightening on the day.
VIX eased to 15.86, a calm volatility backdrop.
A broad risk-on session: NVDA +2.56%, AVGO +6.61%, MU +7.62% and AMD +7.00%, with BTC at 64213 (+1.16%); the S&P 500 closed at fresh highs.

what_changed_today: The total risk score held flat at 41.05 (caution), unchanged on the day.
The 10Y yield eased to 4.70% (from 4.75%) and the 10Y real rate to 2.43% (from 2.47%).
Credit spreads tightened: HY OAS 2.78 (from 2.85) and IG OAS 0.78 (from 0.79); VIX eased to 15.86 (from 15.99).
Semis led the tape (AMD +7.00%, MU +7.62%, AVGO +6.61%, NVDA +2.56%) and the S&P 500 set fresh highs, while the after-hours reaction to AMD and SpaceX earnings was negative.
